:::note[About this page]
This page is generated from the `tools/list` response of [s1000d-verify-mcp](/s1000d-stack/mcp/verify-mcp/) 0.11.0. The s1000d-verify-mcp page explains the configuration and how to read the responses.

## Summary

Verifies one data module in the order well-formedness → XSD → BREX chain → references, and returns `verification` together with the details of each step (line numbers of XSD violations, locations of BREX violations, unresolved references and their reasons). Steps can be skipped with `skip`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Verify one S1000D data module: well-formedness, XML schema (XSD) validation against the user's own S1000D schemas (S1000D_SPEC_DIR), BREX checks along the brexDmRef chain, and reference resolution (dmRef, pmRef, ICN entities, internalRef, applicRefId). Returns a "verification" status (the same VerificationStatus that s1000d-reader-mcp embeds) plus the details of each step. Does NOT decide S1000D conformance.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the data module (or PM) to check. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for referenced data modules, publication modules, ICN files and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; BREX is also searched under S1000D_SPEC_DIR). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `skip` | `array<string>` |  |  | Steps to skip. Skipped steps are reported with state "not-run". |
| `maxSchemaErrors` | `number` |  | default `100` | Cap on XSD errors returned (default 100). The total count is always reported. |
| `maxViolationsPerLayer` | `number` |  | default `200` | Cap on BREX violations returned per layer (default 200). |
| `maxUnresolvedRefs` | `number` |  | default `200` | Cap on unresolved references returned (default 200). |
